dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What big job are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Reprimanding new recruits and fixing morale.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Young people these days are lazy. If no one is strict with them, the entire group becomes one big mess.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: I need to let them know that serving as a guard of Tenshukaku is a precious honor not to be taken lightly!

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: What most people would give for an opportunity like this... They must discipline themselves and work hard to rise through the ranks, just like me!
